locked_before: any provisioning, download, or data contact
version: v2 -- C2: detectability curve RE-ANCHORED on 500p2a win1 (scroll-derived, human-labelled, CLEAN for ink_9um); Frag1 demoted to a non-fatal, non-verdict-bearing SECONDARY arm after its 0.6925/0.4477 KILLED_BASELINE

expA.anchor: 500p2a win1 (y0=12416, x0=6912, 4438px @ 4.32um; rank-1 pairing-weight window; its 469 out-of-mask ink px are excluded from BOTH classes)
expA.scoring: exact tie-corrected pixel rank-AUC on the native 4.32um grid (4438x4438); predictions bilinearly upsampled from the 9.36um maps; 16-bit histogram bins (map*257)
expA.baseline: ink_9um seed42/step-075000 on win1 anti-alias-resampled 4.32->9.36um (the P1-proven pipeline), inferred forward AND reverse; AUC_base = max(fwd,rev)
expA.baseline_gate: if AUC_base < 0.85 the ENTIRE run aborts as KILLED_BASELINE
expA.baseline_gate_justification: 0.85 keeps 0.35 of range above chance, the minimum that can order 12 rungs; UNCHANGED from v1 so the Frag1 and 500p2a anchors face the same bar. Expectation from measured anchors (quoted): in-domain w035 anchor 0.9991 vs our-pipeline P1 reproduction 0.9656 fwd bound the pipeline cost at ~0.03 AUC; with the optical-GT modality gap removed the expected band is ~0.88-0.97. PRE-STATED meaning of a failure: ink_9um does not transfer scroll-to-scroll at curve-anchoring quality even in-modality on a clean human-labelled surface; combined with Frag1's 0.6925 that indicts scroll transfer, not the modality -- shipped as the result; the kill is honored, no re-gating
expA.rung_direction: the baseline argmax direction (tie -> forward) for every rung
expA.detectable_rule: DETECTABLE <=> AUC_rung >= 0.75 AND (AUC_rung-0.5)/(AUC_base-0.5) >= 0.50; detectability limit = coarsest DETECTABLE pitch
expA.pitch_harness: anti-aliased resample 4.32->P (Gaussian sigma=(f-1)/2 source px, linear, grid_mode) then regrid P->9.36 so the model always runs at its trained pitch; measures acquisition information, not model scale sensitivity; the 9.36 rung is identical to baseline by construction (reused) and a pitch_4.32 row (native acquisition) also reuses baseline
expA.noise_rungs: sigma_add = k*sigma_plate for k in {1,2,4,8} on the 9.36 grid, clipped to uint8; sigma_plate = 1.4826*median|(I_z - I_{z+1})/sqrt(2)| over in-mask voxels of the central 17 baseline slices
expA.bitdepth_rungs: the released 4.32um 500p2a volume is ALREADY uint8, so the v1 uint16->uint8 rung is the baseline by construction (reported reused, never re-measured); the informative stressor is bit4: uint8 -> 16 levels via rint(v/17)*17
expA.blur_note: 3D isotropic Gaussian at 9.36um; FWHM 22 and 44 um (PSF-like)

expB.secondary_input: frag1, included iff the non-fatal secondary arm succeeds; reported identically, NEVER verdict-bearing; the overall verdict is computed over the three windows only
expB.win1_reuse: win1's 9.36um fwd/rev cells reuse the EXP A baseline maps (same model, same volume; one inference, two roles)
expB.primary_scale: resampled to 9.36um; native-4.32um passes are sensitivity only, never verdict-bearing
expB.audited_cell: per input, the direction (fwd/rev) with the higher REAL AUC at the primary scale; both directions reported
expB.real_auc: pos = label & mask, neg = mask & ~label; win3 positives are ink AND mask only, its 621303 out-of-mask ink px excluded from both classes
expB.null: 40 rigid translations of the (label & mask) shape image, seed 20260824, drawn once per input on the native grid; |shift|_inf in [4.4mm, 0.40*min(H,W)]; accepted iff >= 50000 pseudo-positive px; pos_i = T_i(shapes) & mask & ~label; neg_i = mask & ~label & ~T_i(shapes) -- the whole comparison lives inside (mask==1 AND label==0)
expB.shape_confounded_threshold: in the audited cell: median of the 40 translated-label AUCs >= 0.60, OR >= 20% of the 40 individually >= 0.60
expB.shape_confounded_justification: a rigid translation carries zero information about true ink; min shift 4.4mm >= ~1.5-2 letter heights so translated strokes cannot overlap their sources; 0.60 is 0.10 above chance, beyond any plausible translation-sampling spread (empirical spread reported beside the verdict), yet far below genuine detection, so real signal cannot trip it. The 20%-of-draws OR-clause catches PERIODIC confounds: text-row structure re-aligns only at shifts near multiples of the line spacing, inflating the null max while leaving the median at or below 0.5 (v1 pre-launch synthetic validation: row-confound null median 0.44, max 0.96); under a clean null, 8 of 40 draws above 0.60 has ~zero probability
expB.genuine_rule: GENUINE <=> not SHAPE-CONFOUNDED, AND AUC_real > max of the 40 translated AUCs (rank p = 1/41 ~= 0.024; every positive beats a matched null), AND gap = AUC_real - median(translated) >= 0.15; otherwise INDETERMINATE
expB.headline: gap = AUC_real - median(translated AUC), reported for every cell

secondary_frag1.status: SECONDARY, NON-FATAL, NON-VERDICT-BEARING; no gate applies to it
secondary_frag1.kept: baseline fwd+rev only: (a) preserves the optical-GT audit input for EXP B, flagged secondary; (b) reproduces the 0.6925/0.4477 KILLED_BASELINE numbers on fresh infra (|new-old| reported)
secondary_frag1.curve_cut: with baseline ~0.69 the DETECTABLE floor (0.75) sits above baseline, so every rung is undetectable by construction; a Frag1 curve is descriptive, not calibrated -- pre-registered CUT (~-$0.5)
secondary_frag1.failure_handling: any secondary failure writes var/secondary_failed; the primary run continues; frag1 is excluded from EXP B and finalize does not require its artifacts

data_gates: exact label-count and sha256 asserts (embedded expectations); any mismatch -> KILLED with evidence
